description: Source file implementing utility functions for sparse-dense product (SDP) backend selection and validation, specifically for flash attention in transformer models.

methods.name: priority_order_cpp
methods.description: Determines the priority order of SDP backends, defaulting to flash attention first, then math.

methods.name: check_head_dim_size_cpp
methods.description: Checks if the last dimension sizes of query, key, and value tensors are equal.

methods.name: use_flash_attention_cpp
methods.description: Determines if flash attention kernel can be used based on parameters and constraints.

methods.name: select_sdp_backend_cpp
methods.description: Selects the appropriate SDP backend based on parameters, constraints, and user settings.
